target_description: Clean-room Centipede-inspired arcade game, touch-first and playable on iPhone Safari; deployed via GitHub Pages at https://github.com/wdavidpence/cenitpede-clone

checklist.item: Phase 0 baseline — repo identity and architecture plan documented
checklist.notes: README.md present; docs/architecture.md and docs/project-plan.md authored

checklist.item: Phase 1 vertical slice — playable game loop with player, mushrooms, centipede, collisions, scoring
checklist.notes: Game loop fixed (rAF single chain, timing reset on restart). Three-way shooting with wing-offset spawn points (left/right bullets emanate from ship wings, not center). Space bar now works as fire key (matches HUD prompt). All core systems verified: spawn/update/render/collision/cleanup/scoring/game-state paths confirmed in full diff audit.

checklist.item: Phase 2 enemy ecology — segment behavior, head turns, spider/flea/scorpion interactions
checklist.notes: Spider distance-based scoring (300/600/900 per authentic disassembly). Flea spawns mushrooms while descending (authentic). Scorpion poisons mushrooms it crosses. Centipede starts with12 segments (authentic), head turns at mushrooms/walls with cooldown gate, tail follows predecessor. Chaser segments use wave-scaled speed. Spawn position corrected (no arbitrary wave*4 offset). Centipede segments nibble mushrooms (HP-1) when crossing them, authentic to arcade. NEW: authentic centipede split mechanic — head hit destroys head and next segment becomes new head of same group (+100); body hit destroys segment and tail behind splits into independent group inheriting parent direction/speed (+10). Cleanup removes empty/dead/off-screen groups.

checklist.item: Phase 3 rules and cabinet feel — scoring tuning, audio, particles, HUD
checklist.notes: Authentic scoring: mushroom=1pt, centipede head=100/body=10, flea=200, scorpion=1000. Extra life every12,000 points (max6, authentic). 6 Web Audio sound effects with wave-transition pitch variation by wave number. Particle FX system with80-particle cap. Screen-flash overlays. HUD shows score, lives, wave, high score with localStorage persistence. Authentic 4-hit mushroom destruction cycle (HP=4, visual degradation per hit, 1pt on destruction). Mushroom regen after player death (one per empty row, authentic escalating difficulty). Poison scales with mushroom HP. NEW: authentic player movement — bottom20% player zone (was33%), 4px/frame speed in all directions (was3), correct collision clamp at H-8 (ship stays on-screen). Touch/keyboard parity maintained via dpad→key mapping.

checklist.item: Phase 4 iPhone Safari hardening — touch-action, safe-area, orientation
checklist.notes: Orientation lock: screen.orientation.lock('portrait-primary') with graceful catch fallback; fullscreen request on game start (iOS Safari user-gesture context). Safe-area layout: env(safe-area-inset-top/right/left/bottom) on HUD, wrapper bottom padding, touch controls left offset. Diagonal movement normalization: vector-based 4px/frame speed in all directions (was ~5.66 diagonally). Touch-action:none on all buttons. Touch slide-off detection on dpad. Viewport-fit=cover in meta. NOT verified on real device — orientation lock and safe-area insets require physical iPhone Safari test.

checklist.item: Autonomous loop infrastructure — STATE.json + supervisor.sh + docs/autonomous-loop.md

last_test_report.details: Scorecard: syntax OK, smoke PASS, all 9 gameplay markers present. Syntax check: inline JS compiles without error. Smoke tests include diagonal normalization tests (cardinal=4px, diagonal normalized to 4px total, zero-movement stays zero). All assertions pass. 275 lines of tests.

next_action: Phase 4 remaining: real-device verification of orientation lock on iPhone Safari, safe-area-inset behavior audit with notch/home indicator, fullscreen API behavior on iOS. Phase 5 candidate: progressive web app manifest + service worker for offline play, or visual polish (parallax starfield, CRT scanline shader).
